decisions.reason: The construction site dumper showed only a brief 2019 website mention and appears to draw less on the firm's distinctive underground and lifting know-how, giving management too little evidence and too little absorptive advantage to justify further development.

The inclined furniture lift fits the firm's established strengths in lifting equipment, safety engineering, customization and service, so management would expect to learn from early field use and improve it commercially.

The inclined building material lift is closely related to the firm's lifting and construction application knowledge, making it a product where existing engineering and service capabilities can be effectively absorbed and extended.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift combines the firm's vehicle and lifting expertise, offering a strong knowledge fit and good scope for iterative improvement through in-house engineering and customer feedback.
